# The 96 configuration keys the deleted C++ firmware exported.
#
# Provenance: `Config::getAllConfigParams()` at `9fa8c834:src/Config.cpp:438`,
# with each key string read off its `ParamDef<T>` declaration in
# `9fa8c834:include/clevercoffee/Config.h`. Recover the list with
#
#     git show 9fa8c834:src/Config.cpp
#
# This is the surface `GET /api/config/download` produced on a C++ machine and
# the surface an operator re-uploads to this firmware, so every key here must
# still resolve. The Rust schema has 98: these 96 plus the two the C++ defines
# but forgets to register (`config_schema.rs:40`).
